data.title: Nvidia Agrees to Buy Open Source AI Platform Hugging Face For $12.9 Billion
data.description: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face, a company known for its GitHub-like repository of open-source AI models, for $12.9 billion, according to a person with knowledge of the agreement.
